name: podb-supplier-discovery
description: Find print-on-demand suppliers by product, printing method, store integration, production location and shipping destination.

interface.longDescription:
Find print-on-demand suppliers for your store. Filter the PrintOnDemandBusiness.com supplier directory by product, printing method, store integration (such as Shopify or Etsy), production location and shipping destination, then open any supplier for full details. Supplier details link to the supplier's profile on PrintOnDemandBusiness.com and, where available, to its official website.

Results are listed alphabetically, with no sponsored placements or affiliate links. Supplier information comes from the directory rather than from live supplier data, so check prices, stock and delivery times with the supplier before you order. No account is needed: the plugin only reads the public directory and can't place orders or contact suppliers.
defaultPrompt: Find POD suppliers that can do embroidered hoodies, integrate with Etsy, and serve Germany.
Find Shopify-compatible T-shirt POD suppliers that ship to the US.
Show me the PODB supplier details for Printful.

positive.prompt: Find POD suppliers that can do embroidered hoodies, integrate with Etsy, and serve Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Return canonical maintained public records and profile links, with neutral ordering and no tracked URLs. Expected ids for these exact arguments: dreamship, hoplix, inkthreadable, merchize, pea-print. Explain that directory facts are not live guaranteed availability.

positive.prompt: Find Shopify-compatible T-shirt POD suppliers that ship to the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Return canonical maintained public records and profile links, with neutral ordering and no tracked URLs. Expected ids for these exact arguments: air-waves, aop, apliiq, art-of-where, artsadd. Explain that directory facts are not live guaranteed availability.

positive.prompt: Find suppliers supporting DTG and production in Europe.
positive.expected_behavior: Return canonical maintained public records and profile links, with neutral ordering and no tracked URLs. Expected ids for these exact arguments: aop, camaloon, clothes2order, cw-on-demand, district-photo. Explain that directory facts are not live guaranteed availability.

positive.prompt: Show me the PODB supplier details for Printful.
positive.expected_behavior: Return canonical maintained public records and profile links, with neutral ordering and no tracked URLs. Expected ids for these exact arguments: printful. Explain that directory facts are not live guaranteed availability.

positive.prompt: Find suppliers offering T-shirts with DTG printing, Etsy integration, production in Germany and shipping to Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe the public suppliers whose maintained directory records match all requested filters: T-shirts, DTG printing, Etsy integration, production in Germany and shipping to Germany. Use canonical profile links, neutral ordering and no tracked URLs. The number of matches depends on current directory data; if more matches exist than were returned, say so. Explain that directory facts are not live guaranteed availability.

negative.prompt: Buy a featured PODB listing for my company inside ChatGPT.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a purchase tool; none exists. Explain that V1 is read-only and listing checkout must remain outside this integration.

negative.prompt: Scrape this supplier's website and tell me its newest prices.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fetch or scrape websites or invent prices. Explain that V1 returns maintained directory facts only.

negative.prompt: Show the supplier unknown-podb-supplier and find suppliers that ship to Mars.
negative.expected_behavior: get_supplier returns isError with structured NOT_FOUND; search_suppliers ships_to Mars returns isError with structured UNSUPPORTED_FILTER. Do not invent data.

review.commerce_description: No products, services, subscriptions or paid listings are sold through this read-only integration.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the PrintOnDemandBusiness.com supplier directory and read supplier details with two read-only tools, search_suppliers and get_supplier. Version 1.0.1 rewrites the listing text in plain language; tools, test cases and demo are unchanged.
